description: Input: the same fields as quote_image, plus attempt. Generate one image from a prompt (paid): a NEW run of skill generate_image, charged the quoted credits per image once it is delivered. Call quote_image first and show the user the price. Call get_run with its poll.arguments; once it succeeded, generation.url is the image and its run_id can be a reference of a later generation. A reference is {upload_id, rights_confirmed: true} for a picture from upload_image or create_upload (rights_confirmed states you may use the people and works in it), {run_id} of a succeeded generate_image run of this account until its reusable_until, or {asset_id} of a picture asset from create_asset, whose rights were confirmed when it was made. A generation that fails is charged nothing. An identical request returns the same run it started before, so a call repeated after a lost answer starts nothing new; to make another one with the same request on purpose, pass attempt 2. While generations are closed it answers generations_disabled or generations_marking_pending and charges nothing. Price: seedream-5.0-flash: 3 credits per image; flare: 4 credits per image. Quote first with quote_image; list_prices names every price.
name: generate_image
title: Generate an image
